rows.label: tlk70000022_01_msg0001
rows.name:
The capital has a long history. Some
old establishments have been here for
more than 300 years.

rows.label: tlk70000022_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm the fourteenth master myself, and
I've worked on construction and
repairs throughout this country.

rows.label: tlk70000022_01_msg0003
rows.name:
But carrying on tradition while also
adapting to the times is no easy task.

rows.label: tlk70000022_01_msg0004
rows.name:
This city's built on blood, sweat
and tears. More than you know.
